evidenceLineItems.label: Refund / return policy
evidenceLineItems.reason: Documents merchant policy, but does not by itself prove authorization for this fraud dispute.

evidenceLineItems.label: Customer correspondence
evidenceLineItems.reason: No customer correspondence is on file for this order. Upload a transcript from your helpdesk to add one.

evidenceLineItems.label: Tracking status
evidenceLineItems.reason: The carrier delivered this parcel back to you. Because the customer never took delivery, no proof of delivery can exist for this order — so the case cannot be argued on delivery. What matters now is why it came back, and what you did with the goods.

evidenceLineItems.label: Returned Parcel Outcome
evidenceLineItems.reason: Field is on file but no usable evidence payload was emitted.

evidenceLineItems.label: order_confirmation
evidenceLineItems.reason: Confirms order details, but does not prove the customer authorized the transaction.

internalSignals.label: Billing and shipping addresses on the order agree
internalSignals.reason: The billing and shipping addresses you hold for this order have the same city and country. This is an internal note about your own order record, not evidence: it is not a check by the cardholder's bank, so it is never scored and never included in the dispute response. Address verification comes from the issuer's AVS result on the payment row.

evidenceLineItems.label: activity_log
evidenceLineItems.reason: Included in the defence package as context, not as decisive proof.

evidenceLineItems.label: customer_account_info
evidenceLineItems.reason: First-time customer (account created October 2026, no prior orders). Included as context only — there is no prior order history to corroborate this transaction.

evidenceLineItems.label: shipping_policy
evidenceLineItems.reason: Documents shipping commitments; supporting context only.

evidenceLineItems.label: cancellation_policy
evidenceLineItems.reason: Documents cancellation rules; supporting context only.

evidenceLineItems.label: avs_cvv_match
evidenceLineItems.reason: The payment processor did not return AVS or CVV verification codes for this transaction. Nothing to include — these codes come from the payment gateway at checkout, not after the fact.

evidenceLineItems.label: ip_location_check
evidenceLineItems.reason: The order IP geolocated to the same country as the billing and shipping address, with no VPN, proxy, or datacenter signals. Cited as supporting context — consistent with a cardholder-originated transaction.

latest.failure_reason: Only the store's own records (policies, the order) are citable; they are context, not an argument.
